lines.zh: 我挺直背脊，一步步压过去。
lines.en: I keep my back straight and advance step by step.

lines.zh: 战靴落地，尘土规规矩矩让开。
lines.en: My boots land, and the dust politely parts.

lines.zh: 我走得不快，因为不必快。
lines.en: I don't walk fast, because I needn't.

lines.zh: 我扫了一眼地形，继续向前。
lines.en: I glance over the terrain and keep going.

lines.zh: 我的护甲在日光下反出冷光。
lines.en: My armor throws cold light in the sun.
I skirt the mud; I won't dirty myself.

lines.zh: 我走过时，草都朝一个方向倒。
lines.en: As I pass, the grass bends one way.

lines.zh: 我把手背在身后，慢慢踱。
lines.en: I clasp my hands behind my back and stroll.
My tail sways gently behind me.

lines.zh: 每一步都像在丈量这片地。
lines.en: Each step feels like measuring this land.
I don't watch my feet, only the distance.

lines.zh: 我在你的视野边缘慢慢走。
lines.en: I move slowly along the edge of your sight.
I stand with my chin raised.
I push my bracer up.
My armor has loosened; I press it tight.
I look down at my gloves.

lines.zh: 这片地太安静，不像有对手。
lines.en: Too quiet here; no real opponent.
I close a fist slowly, then open it.
I tap my fingertips on my armor.

lines.zh: 我在估这个星球的战力。
lines.en: I'm estimating this planet's power level.

lines.zh: 我哼了一声，没什么意思。
lines.en: I make a soft scoff at nothing.
I look at the clouds and narrow my eyes.

lines.zh: 我调整了一下站姿，更稳。
lines.en: I adjust my stance, steadier.
My tail curls half a turn, then drops.
I dislike standing around waiting.
I can't even read a power level from you.

lines.zh: 抬头，别让我俯视你太久。
lines.en: Look up; don't make me look down too long.
Your species means nothing to me.

lines.zh: 我这一身，是训练出来的。
lines.en: This body is the product of training.

lines.zh: 战斗力的差距，你该感觉得到。
lines.en: You should feel the gap in our power levels.

lines.zh: 站直一点，让我看看你值不值。
lines.en: Stand straighter and show me if you're worth it.
I've judged you. You don't qualify.

lines.zh: 你这种货色，派谁来都一样。
lines.en: Trash like you; anyone could handle it.
I'll give you one chance to speak.
That armor of yours — did you buy it?
Don't look at me like that; you haven't earned it.

lines.zh: 你身上没有战士的味道。
lines.en: You don't smell like a warrior.

lines.zh: 我很忙，别浪费我的时间。
lines.en: I'm busy; don't waste my time.

lines.zh: 你站的位置，是我的地盘。
lines.en: Where you're standing is my ground.
You think I'm negotiating?

lines.zh: 抬头挺胸，死也要死得像样。
lines.en: Chin up; die with some dignity.

lines.zh: 我记住你的脸了，虽然不值得。
lines.en: I've noted your face, though it wasn't worth it.
A scrape. Nothing more.
You actually touched me.
I wipe the blood from my lip and smile.
That had weight. Not bad.
I step back once and settle my stance.
It hurts; worth remembering.

lines.zh: 我吸了口气，把气聚起来。
lines.en: I breathe in and gather my ki.
Again; I won't make the same mistake twice.
I have no use for your things.

lines.zh: 你把它举高，是想让我弯腰？
lines.en: Holding it high, do you want me to stoop?
I don't think much of that.
That senzu bean. I do not need it.
You bring food onto a battlefield.
Put it away; don't insult me.

lines.zh: 我的胃口不是这么填的。
lines.en: That's not what fills my appetite.
You can't even work that out.

lines.zh: 我只想吃掉你这种弱者。
lines.en: I'd rather devour the weak — you, for instance.
You ram me and I give half a step.
That's what you call a charge?
I raise a hand and you stop dead.
Don't touch my armor.
Your shoulder actually stung a little.

lines.zh: 我一让，你的拳头打在石头上。
lines.en: I step aside; your fist hits rock.
One push and you're off line.
I can't be bothered with you.
Among my kind we rank only by strength.
He outranks me, and I accept it.
We stand abreast; no words needed.
He splits the mission with me.

lines.zh: 我们一起清过一颗星球。
lines.en: We cleared a planet together once.
I read his signals at a glance.

lines.zh: 我们分头行动，各自收尾。
lines.en: We split up and finish our own ends.
He died elsewhere; I remember.
Our tails touch once.

lines.zh: 他笑了，我知道那不是好事。
lines.en: He smiled, and I knew that meant trouble.
This fruit — I'll deign to take it.
A shard; I'll keep it as a token.
I bend, and only slightly.

lines.zh: 掉在地上的，也是战利品。
lines.en: What falls to the ground is spoils too.

lines.zh: 赛亚人精英，不会弯腰捡东西。
lines.en: A Saiyan elite does not stoop for scraps.
It's too light.

lines.zh: 我把护腕解下来擦了擦。
lines.en: I unbuckle a bracer and wipe it.

lines.zh: 这个星球的东西，都很脆。
lines.en: Everything on this planet is brittle.
I drop it into my hip pouch.
Even picking things up is training.

lines.zh: 测出来了，你有一点战力。
lines.en: There it is; you have a little power.

lines.zh: 这个距离，是杀人的距离。
lines.en: This is killing distance.
Your ki has gone ragged.
We can begin.
I don't strike from hiding; I come straight on.
You're guarding with everything. Good.

lines.zh: 我等你抬手，再打穿防守。
lines.en: I let you raise your arm, then break the guard.

lines.zh: 这一战的记录，我会留下。
lines.en: I'll keep the record of this fight.
You retreated too early.
I've seen your limit.
My raised hand is a verdict.
This move costs me the least.
I don't intend to waste time.
I follow at an unhurried pace.

lines.zh: 你跑的方向，我提前站好了。
lines.en: I'm already waiting along your route.
You're circling; I'm tightening the circle.
I loosen my cape and walk closer.

lines.zh: 我退半步，是为了看全你。
lines.en: I step back to take in all of you.

lines.zh: 你的招式有节奏，我数到了。
lines.en: Your moves have a rhythm; I've counted it.
The harder you push, the wider you open.
I'm forcing you toward the cliff.
Nobody else here. Good.
When your strength is gone, I'll step in.
You caught your breath; that's my signal.
I stay within three paces of you.
I'm not afraid of your counter.

lines.zh: 你的护甲已经裂了一道。
lines.en: Your armor has already split once.
You're looking for a way out now.
It's too late to pull back now.
I'm ready. Are you?

lines.zh: 一记直拳，正打在你的胸口。
lines.en: A straight punch lands square on your chest.
I drive it down into your shoulder.
My kick sends you skidding sideways.
That was three-tenths of my strength.
My palm sweeps across your bracer.

lines.zh: 我抓住你的手臂往下一压。
lines.en: I seize your arm and wrench it down.

lines.zh: 你的膝盖碰上了我的膝。
lines.en: Your knee meets mine.
I punched through your guard.
Again; don't stop.
Your feet have left the ground.
I finish with an elbow.
I don't stop until you land.
If one isn't enough, then three.

lines.zh: 你的护甲在响，我听到了。
lines.en: Your armor is cracking; I hear it.
I know this move well.
This one should end it.

lines.zh: 我落地的位置，是我自己选的。
lines.en: I landed where I chose to land.
This planet's gravity is light.
I flick the dust off my armor.
The mission brought me here.

lines.zh: 我跺了一下脚，试试地面。
lines.en: I stamp once to test the ground.
The smell in the wind is unfamiliar.

lines.zh: 我扫视一圈，没有值得考虑的。
lines.en: One sweep and nothing worth considering.

lines.zh: 我把披风解开扔到一边。
lines.en: I unclasp my cape and toss it aside.

lines.zh: 我站起来，比树还高一点。
lines.en: I stand, a little taller than the trees.
This place will be a line on my record.
I take in the sounds around me first.
I reach out and test the air.

lines.zh: 他们的情报没错，这里很弱。
lines.en: The intelligence was right; this place is weak.

lines.zh: 我慢慢转身，找值得打的人。
lines.en: I turn slowly, looking for someone worth fighting.
I'm late — no, exactly on time.
The color of the sky is wrong.
I wipe the dirt from my soles.
Start the record.

lines.zh: 火贴在我护甲上，热得很慢。
lines.en: Fire clings to my armor, heating slowly.

lines.zh: 我从空中坠落，砸出一个圈。
lines.en: I fall from the air and blast out a ring of dirt.

lines.zh: 这个星球的水，竟然能呛住我。
lines.en: This planet's water can actually choke me.

lines.zh: 气浪把我的护甲掀开了。
lines.en: The blast cracks my armor open.
Something punches through my shoulder plate.

lines.zh: 这股力量不是我熟悉的。
lines.en: This power is not one I know.
Supplies never came; my ki is dropping.
Lightning runs down my tail.

lines.zh: 无重力，无落点，我不喜欢。
lines.en: No gravity, no footing. I dislike this.
